component.name: Byakaron
component.summary: Type Bangla phonetically and check spelling

description.p: Byakaron is a Bangla phonetic input method and companion app. Type with a Latin keyboard and compose Bangla with Avro phonetic rules.
The app provides a Bangla spell checker, an Avro key-map reference, and a guide for adding the system input source in GNOME.
One install command for Intel/AMD and ARM, Raspberry Pi OS and KDE setup, a fix for Qt apps on Ubuntu 20.04/22.04, and better-ranked suggestions.
Arrow keys pick a suggestion, spelling corrections while typing, a personal dictionary, and a Settings page with a Bangla digits switch.
The Byakaron logo now shows in the app grid, dock and keyboard settings (0.1.8 showed a blank icon).
New Byakaron logo. Spell-checking long documents no longer freezes the window. Qt apps no longer type a word twice when you click while composing it.
